title: IMAGIN.studio stellt Fahrzeugvisualisierungs-Layer für die Auto-Abonnement-Plattform von FINN bereit
ai_summary: IMAGIN.studio is providing a vehicle visualization layer for FINN's auto subscription platform, generating on-demand vehicle images based on model, trim, color, wheels, and angle. The partnership aims to deliver over 100 million images monthly as the platform expands. The collaboration follows FINN's recent Series D funding round exceeding €1 billion.

title: Finn Raises €140M in Series D Funding
ai_summary: Finn, a Munich-based car subscription platform, raised €140M in a Series D round led by Portage, achieving a $1B+ valuation. The company will use the capital to expand in Germany and the US, scale TV marketing, and grow fleet capacity. It reports over 50,000 active subscribers generating €300M in annual recurring revenue.
